name: Root Cause Weekend, The Original Method
summary: A solo weekend in a cabin practising the Original Method: a morning and evening session on video, silent mornings, and long practice in between. Hard physically. Some yoga experience needed. $160.
description:
The Original Method is the only complete system that addresses the true root of suffering. Other practices treat symptoms; the Method removes the cause.

**Your weekend**
Silent mornings. A 90-minute video session at 6am and 6pm, led by the Method's senior instructors, which you follow alone in your cabin. Between sessions you practise the sequences on your own; the Method requires at least four hours of practice a day to take effect. A Method guide is available by phone for questions.

**Why the Method**
Practitioners of yoga, meditation, and therapy come to us after years of partial results. What they were missing is the Method. It is not a variation on other practices; it is the practice they were all incomplete attempts at. We say this plainly because people deserve to know.

**Level**
Some experience of yoga is helpful so the sequences are physically accessible.

**Physical**
Demanding: four to six hours of practice a day.

**Cost**
$160 including the cabin and video access.
practical: Friday evening to Sunday afternoon, year round. $160. One person per cabin, six cabins. Cabin with screen, mat, kitchenette. Bring food and practice clothing. Directions sent on booking. Wifi for the sessions.
